subject: Typewriting
examFormat: The examination lasts 2 hours 45 minutes: 5 minutes warming up on the Council's material (not counted), 5 minutes for a speed and accuracy test, 10 minutes reading through the paper and 2 hours 30 minutes for production tasks. The speed and accuracy test is set at 40 words per minute (syllabic intensity 1.35-1.40) and carries 10 percent of the marks. The production test has a maximum of 5 tasks; total standard words range between 1350 and 1450, and the number of instructions attracting penalties between 40 and 50.

topics.name: Correspondence
objectives: Type letters and memoranda on pre-printed A4 and A5 headed paper with insets, continuation sheets, subject headings, enclosures and attention lines, including private, personal, confidential and indicating distribution of carbon copies
Type form letters and circular letters with or without tear-off portions
Address envelopes, including envelopes with special marks

topics.name: Manuscript
objectives: Type manuscript with or without inset matter

topics.name: Display Work
topics.content: Tasks may be presented in a mixture of manuscript, typescript and printed drafts with interpolations and manuscript correction signs.

subtopics.name: Headings
objectives: Type main, sub-heading, shoulder, paragraph and marginal/side headings

subtopics.name: Paragraphing
objectives: Type blocked, indented and hanging paragraphs

subtopics.name: Paragraph Numbering
objectives: Number paragraphs using Arabic, Roman, decimal and alphabetical numbering

subtopics.name: Display Work Documents
objectives: Type a menu, advertisement and itinerary

subtopics.name: Meetings and Report
objectives: Type a notice of meeting (with or without agenda), chairman's agenda, minutes and reports

subtopics.name: Business Forms, Cards etc.
objectives: Complete pre-printed forms: application and personal records forms, invoices, order forms, delivery notes, advice notes, invitation cards and postcards

subtopics.name: Tabulation
objectives: Type tabulation with ruling, with or without leader dots, in chronological and alphabetical arrangements

subtopics.name: Literary Work
objectives: Type short plays, poems and articles, including footnotes

subtopics.name: Financial Statement
objectives: Type a simple statement of accounts
